title: Pay coin access and return at the reached positive-half site
body:
The PR6092 half kernel assumes a resident coin. This package supplies literal access and return from a preserved random tape for historical5599 event52, leaving the half payload unchanged. The source slice proves reached x=x345_initial+x93_initial, so B-bit signed originals need exactly W=B+1 bits. A declared fixed-draw packing places this coin at offset11; this is a new explicit layout convention, not an inherited physical ABI.

The three-tape FHF program costs exactly2L+8W+110 transitions per direction and occupies L+6W+70 visited cells, including the full marked program and random interval. PROOF.md proves the all-width endpoint/inverse and accounts for all head returns. Setup, clean allocation, packed caller presentation and random generation remain supplied premises with separate charges; no full-prefix, native-MOVE, supplier, speedup or kappa claim.

Registered normal/-O checks pass with identical receipts:704 local rows,680 exhaustive signed-pair/coin cases,64 larger endpoints,4,629,600 literal transitions and8 exact-reason rejecting controls. All16 committed package/input bytes and declared source history pass transport checks. Separate proof and source review are AI checks, not human/kernel acceptance or hostedCI.

Base2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc; revision8/selected6030 unchanged. [Canonical claim/finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6073#discussioncomment-19285346). Exact sources, current overlap, reproduction and next obligations are in README/TASK/SOURCES/VALIDATION. No frozen predecessor or shared code is edited.

Credit zxv/PR6092/6066, JoyboyBrian/PR6095, Nick Petalas/PR6026, Ali Romman/PR5599 and retained lineage. AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
